```{r}
# Filter the raw FHB phenotype file to only the accessions on your list,
# matching on either the accession name or its synonym(s).

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(writexl)   

#install.packages(c("readxl","dplyr","stringr","tidyr","writexl"))



```


```{r}

# ---- EDIT THESE to match your files and column names ------------------------
raw_file      <- "raw_NUWWSN.csv"
list_file     <- "samplename_request.xlsx"
raw_name_col  <- "germplasmName"   # accession name column in the raw file
raw_syn_col   <- "germplasmSynonyms"     # synonym column in the raw file
list_name_col <- "FullSampleName"   # accession column in your list file
year_col      <- "studyYear"        # used to sort earliest -> latest
syn_delim     <- "[,]"        # how multiple synonyms are separated in one cell
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

raw  <- readr::read_csv(raw_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
keep <- read_excel(list_file)

# Normalise names so "PI 12345", "pi12345" and "PI-12345 " all match
clean <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_upper(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  str_remove_all(x, "[\\s_-]")
}

raw <- raw %>% mutate(.row = row_number())

# Every name each raw row is known by (main name + each synonym)
raw_names <- raw %>%
  transmute(.row,
            name = as.character(.data[[raw_name_col]]),
            syn  = as.character(.data[[raw_syn_col]])) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(name, syn), names_to = "matched_via", values_to = "id") %>%
  separate_longer_delim(id, delim = regex(syn_delim)) %>%
  mutate(key = clean(id)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key), key != "", key != "NA")

list_keys <- keep %>%
  transmute(list_name = as.character(.data[[list_name_col]]),
            key = clean(list_name)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key), key != "") %>%
  distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Match; prefer a match on the main name over a synonym
matches <- raw_names %>%
  inner_join(list_keys, by = "key") %>%
  arrange(.row, matched_via) %>%            # "name" sorts before "syn"
  group_by(.row) %>%
  summarise(n_list_hits = n_distinct(list_name),
            list_name   = first(list_name),
            matched_via = first(matched_via),
            .groups = "drop")

filtered <- raw %>%
  inner_join(matches, by = ".row") %>%
  relocate(list_name, matched_via, .after = all_of(raw_name_col)) %>%
  arrange(.data[[year_col]]) %>%
  select(-.row)

# Accessions on your list that were not found in the raw file at all
not_found <- list_keys %>%
  anti_join(raw_names, by = "key") %>%
  select(list_name)

# Raw rows whose names/synonyms hit more than one accession on your list
ambiguous <- filtered %>% filter(n_list_hits > 1)

write_xlsx(list(filtered = select(filtered, -n_list_hits),
                not_found = not_found,
                ambiguous = ambiguous),
           "raw_filtered.xlsx")

message(nrow(raw), " raw rows -> ", nrow(filtered), " kept\n",
        n_distinct(filtered$list_name), " of ", nrow(list_keys),
        " list accessions found (", sum(filtered$matched_via == "syn"),
        " rows matched via synonym)\n",
        nrow(not_found), " list accessions not found -> see 'not_found' sheet\n",
        nrow(ambiguous), " ambiguous rows -> see 'ambiguous' sheet")

```


```{r}
#Combining NUWWSN and CUHB
raw_a <- readr::read_csv("raw_NUWWSN.csv", show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c"))
raw_b <- readr::read_csv("CUHB_raw.csv", show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c"))

# 1. Compare column names: run these and look at the output
setdiff(names(raw_a), names(raw_b))   # only in raw
setdiff(names(raw_b), names(raw_a))   # only in new

# If the same column is spelled differently, rename it in 'new' to match raw, e.g.:
# raw_b <- rename(raw_b, Year = YEAR, Incidence = INC)

# 2. Stack them. Columns only in one file get NA for the other file's rows
raw <- bind_rows(
  mutate(raw_a, across(everything(), as.character), source_file = "raw"),
  mutate(raw_b, across(everything(), as.character), source_file = "new")
) %>%
  readr::type_convert(na = c("", "NA", ".", "-", "*", "n/a"))
```
